sql: SELECT trip_date, avg_total_amount AS avg_total_amount, trips AS trips, avg_trip_distance AS avg_trip_distance FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-27') ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 500
